sections.heading: C2 — Knowledge continuation and confusables: Emergencies, malfunctions and crashes
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Knowledge continuation and confusables: Emergencies, malfunctions and crashes

FACT_ID: sec16-R01 | anchor: A59
An uninvolved driver should not stop at a crash when emergency help is already present, but should keep watching for people near the road. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R02 | anchor: A59
Do not travel to a crash, fire or disaster merely to look, because spectators may block rescue vehicles. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R03 | anchor: A59
A driver involved in a crash must stop and must try to find the owner after striking a parked vehicle. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R04 | anchor: A59
Notify police when anyone is injured or killed; an involved driver must not leave before police obtain the needed crash information. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R05 | anchor: A59
The handbook suggests carrying an emergency kit with warning flares, first-aid supplies and basic tools. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R06 | anchor: A59
Lap and shoulder belts are the handbook’s primary advice for reducing injury when a collision cannot be avoided. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R07 | anchor: A59
For a rear impact, press against the seatback, place the head against the restraint and prepare to brake against being pushed into another vehicle. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R08 | anchor: A59
For a side impact, the handbook says belts help retain position while the driver prepares to steer or brake against another collision. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R09 | anchor: A59
Front air bags do not provide the side-impact protection described in the handbook’s side-collision discussion. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R10 | anchor: A59
If a frontal impact is unavoidable, the handbook recommends trying for a glancing collision through steering rather than a direct head-on blow. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R11 | anchor: A59
The frontal-impact discussion anticipates air-bag inflation and deflation and emphasizes belt use and readiness to prevent a second crash. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R12 | anchor: A59
Stop at or near the crash site and move a drivable vehicle off the roadway to avoid blocking traffic or causing another crash. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R13 | anchor: A59
Do not stand or walk in traffic lanes at a crash scene. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R14 | anchor: A59
Turn off wrecked-vehicle ignitions and do not smoke nearby because spilled fuel may ignite. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R15 | anchor: A59
Stay away from fallen power lines on or near the road. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R16 | anchor: A59
Use flares or other warning devices to keep approaching traffic from becoming involved. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R17 | anchor: A59
For injuries, call police and emergency medical or rescue help and report any fire when calling. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R18 | anchor: A59
Do not move an injured person unless the vehicle is burning or immediate danger of another vehicle striking makes movement necessary. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R19 | anchor: A59
The handbook prioritizes people who are not already walking and talking, checking breathing before bleeding. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R20 | anchor: A59
For bleeding, the handbook advises direct pressure on the wound using a hand or cloth. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R21 | anchor: A59
Give an injured person nothing to drink, including water. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R22 | anchor: A59
Use a coat or blanket to keep an injured person warm as the handbook’s shock-prevention advice. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R23 | anchor: A60
Collect the names and addresses of everyone involved and witnesses, including injured people. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R24 | anchor: A60
Exchange names, addresses, license numbers, vehicle plate and descriptive information, and available insurer and policy details with the other drivers. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R25 | anchor: A60
Record vehicle damage and provide crash information to police or emergency officials when requested. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R26 | anchor: A60
After striking a parked vehicle, try to find the owner; if unsuccessful, leave visible contact information with the crash date and time. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R27 | anchor: A60
For an injury or death, contact police and give crash information at the time of the crash, then notify your insurer as soon as possible. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R28 | anchor: A60
If injuries prevent the driver completing a crash report, another person may file it. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R29 | anchor: A60
After damaging unattended property without locating its owner, contact the nearest law-enforcement agency and leave a note where the owner can find it. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R30 | anchor: A60
That unattended-property note must list contact details, driver-license and plate numbers, crash date and time, and damage. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R31 | anchor: A60
The unattended-property section advises waiting for law enforcement and warns that leaving a crash scene is unlawful. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R32 | anchor: A60
The printed injury-and-fatal-crash table ranks careless driving first, close following second and impaired driving third. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R33 | anchor: A60
The same printed table places failure to stop fourth, improper turns fifth and disobeying traffic controls sixth. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R34 | anchor: A60
The table’s remaining positions are overdriving conditions seventh, reckless driving eighth, emerging from an alley ninth and failing to report a crash tenth. [A60]
Source: [A60 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0060]

ranked.label: Pedagogic emphasis: Choose the response for the actual emergency and preserve crash-scene duties.

corpus_stability.reason: The official dated snapshot is pinned, but revision frequency has not been measured. Unknown cadence remains blocked for release pending the section-A verification debt; this is not a claim that the handbook is volatile.
